name: Angelic Parfait
original_name: エンジェリックパフェ
source:
Cafeteria stands quietly in the suburbs of the city. It is opened by main character's grandfather as a means to heal hearts of people around, but he would be shocked by the amount of corruption this place accumulated under his grandson management...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一间餐厅静静伫立在城市郊外。主人公的祖父开办它，本是为了治愈周围人们的心灵；然而若他看见孙子经营期间，这里已经积累了多少腐化与堕落，恐怕会大吃一惊……

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
